'''New Meen''' was a seedy town on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], near [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] mines. [[Angu Drombb]], one of [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo's]] henchmen, tried to frighten the inhabitants to gain control of the ryll [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trade during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="LongArm" />
